baseline.method: Actual original parameter-free Weiss, full dinosaur, measured independent references

nrmse_definition: RMS error after a single optimal positive scale per submitted field on the public foreground, divided by the dynamic range of its independent measured reference. Scalar a=max(0,dot(x,y)/dot(x,x)).
source_lmse_definition: Author 20x20 windows, step10, scalar per window if sum(x*x*mask)>1e-5 else zero, summed squared residual divided by summed reference squared intensity. Each field evaluated separately.
